scope: Application-held capture policy: six real Qt synthetic Launch cases, fourteen PE32 ownership cases, fresh input/queue/fallback regressions and isolated original idle World for120 seconds without injected reader failures. No hours-long battle, NVIDIA desktop, movie, synchronized gameplay pixels or replacement guarantee. Historical failed user run remains a separate environment/workload observation.

failed_user_run.classification: Retained user run with observer readback enabled and no native command channel; four original BltFast DDERR_SURFACEBUSY failures. Observer-lock interference is implicated, exact lock/DC holder was not measured.

launch.scope: Real Qt shell Launch button with synthetic producer, default/explicit continuous and explicit bounded selection, composed pixels in normal/fullscreen and high-DPI windows. Optional prior captures are read-only startup observations. No new original game or user-driver validation.

ownership.scope: Fourteen synthetic PE32 application-held Lock/Unlock cases; original fake Lock counts prohibit observer locks, Unlock poisons memory, HRESULT/LastError and failed-unlock retry are checked. No real driver or concurrent-game guarantee.

campaign.scope: Original campaign ingress through three forwarded World ticks, bounded World observation, optional independent tutorial summon/control-count checks and classified native refusal, and movie-enabled startup; finite 16 ms native observation, forced failed-reader recovery and independent unsynchronized stable X11 ROI comparisons. No full-frame, gameplay animation, movie frame or hardware-driver equivalence; no replacement.

hosting.scope: Synthetic Xvfb/Mesa: bounded FIFO command execution with queued presentation and no synchronous reader repaints, event delivery between polls, latest retained full pixels and actual Qt shell final-frame drain beyond 4096 commands. Targeted input and recovery regressions. No original execution, user hardware latency, producer contention repair or live replacement claim.

fallback.scope: Synthetic actual-shell GAP/retry exhaustion, foreign-window attachment, inactive forwarded lease and direct X11 mouse/key delivery; normal/fullscreen. No original execution or user-hardware latency claim.

attempts.outcome: Wrong nested build path; no original experiment ran.
Existing forced-reader-failure procedure exhausted recovery before sustained observation. No busy error seen in the short run; not long-run evidence.
